a tight schedule: Because the tour runs on a tight schedule, we only have twenty minutes at each stop, so please don't be late.
因為這趟旅程的時程很緊湊，我們在每一站只有二十分鐘，所以請不要遲到。
a tight budget: We are on a tight budget this month, so we will cook at home instead of eating out.
我們這個月預算緊縮，所以會在家煮飯，而不是外出用餐。
tight security: There was tight security at the airport after the threat, with police checking every bag and passenger.
在威脅事件後，機場有嚴密的安全措施，警察檢查每一件行李和每一位旅客。
a tight race: It was a tight race between the two runners, and the winner crossed the line only a second ahead.
那是兩位跑者之間勢均力敵的競賽，勝利者只領先一秒衝過終點線。
in a tight spot: I was in a tight spot when I lost my wallet abroad, but a kind stranger lent me some money.
我在國外弄丟錢包時處於困境，但一位好心的陌生人借了我一些錢。
keep a tight rein on: Families should keep a tight rein on their spending during hard times so that they can save for emergencies.
在困難時期，家庭應該嚴格控制開銷，以便存錢應付緊急狀況。
tight controls: The government placed tight controls on the import of meat to stop the disease from spreading.
政府對肉品進口實施嚴格管制，以阻止疾病擴散。
a tight deadline: The reporters were working against a tight deadline, with only two hours to finish the story before printing.
記者們正在趕一個緊迫的期限，在印刷前只有兩個小時完成報導。
sit tight: Please sit tight and stay in your seats; the bus will start moving again once the road is cleared.
請耐心等待並留在座位上；道路一清空，公車就會再次出發。
money is tight: Money is tight for our family since Dad lost his job, so we have stopped buying anything we don't need.
自從爸爸失業後，我們家手頭很緊，所以我們不再買任何不需要的東西。
a timid smile: The new student gave us a timid smile and quietly sat down in the back of the classroom.
新同學對我們露出怯生生的微笑，然後安靜地坐到教室後面。
a timid approach: The company took a timid approach to the new market, afraid of taking risks and losing money.
這家公司對新市場採取畏首畏尾的做法，害怕冒險和賠錢。
timid about speaking up: Jenny is timid about speaking up in class, so she rarely answers questions even when she knows the answer.
珍妮在課堂上不敢發言，所以即使她知道答案也很少回答問題。
a tolerable level of noise: The new windows reduced the traffic sounds to a tolerable level of noise, so we can finally sleep well.
新窗戶把車流聲降到可忍受的噪音程度，所以我們終於可以好好睡覺了。
tolerable weather: It was very hot, but with a cool breeze it was tolerable weather, so we could still walk around the market.
天氣很熱，但有涼風吹著，算是還過得去的天氣，所以我們還是可以逛市場。
within tolerable limits: The doctor said his blood pressure is still within tolerable limits, but he should eat less salt.
醫生說他的血壓仍在可容忍的範圍內，但他應該少吃鹽。
be tolerant of other views: In a democracy, people should be tolerant of other views, even when they strongly disagree with them.
在民主社會中，人們應該包容不同的觀點，即使他們強烈反對。
a tolerant society: A tolerant society accepts people of different religions, cultures, and lifestyles and treats them all with respect.
包容的社會接納不同宗教、文化和生活方式的人，並尊重地對待他們所有人。
drought-tolerant plants: Since it rarely rains here, we grow drought-tolerant plants such as cactus that need very little water.
因為這裡很少下雨，我們種植像仙人掌這種需水量很少的耐旱植物。
be tolerant toward: We should be tolerant toward people whose customs are different from ours instead of laughing at them.
我們應該對習俗和我們不同的人寬容，而不是嘲笑他們。
a tough decision: Choosing between studying abroad and staying near my family was a tough decision that kept me awake for nights.
在出國留學和留在家人身邊之間做選擇是個艱難的決定，讓我好幾個晚上睡不著。
tough competition: Our team faces tough competition in the final, since the other team has won the championship three times.
我們的隊伍在決賽中面臨激烈的競爭，因為對手已經拿過三次冠軍。
tough measures: To stop drunk driving, the city introduced tough measures, such as huge fines and even prison for repeat offenders.
為了遏止酒駕，市政府推出嚴厲的措施，例如高額罰款，累犯甚至要坐牢。
a tough question: The interviewer asked me a tough question about my weaknesses, and I didn't know how to answer at first.
面試官問了我一個關於我缺點的難題，我一開始不知道該怎麼回答。
get tough on crime: The new mayor promised to get tough on crime by hiring more police officers and giving harsher punishments.
新市長承諾要嚴厲打擊犯罪，增聘更多警察並施以更嚴厲的懲罰。
tough luck: You missed the last train? Tough luck—you'll have to take a taxi home or wait until tomorrow morning.
你錯過末班車了？真不幸——你只好搭計程車回家，或等到明天早上。
a tough customer: The lawyer is a tough customer who never gives up easily, so the other side will have trouble winning.
那位律師是個難對付的人，從不輕易放棄，所以對方很難勝訴。
tough love: Some parents believe in tough love, refusing to give their adult children money so they learn to be independent.
有些父母相信嚴厲的愛，拒絕給成年子女錢，好讓他們學會獨立。
when the going gets tough: When the going gets tough, real friends stay by your side and help you through hard times.
當情況艱難時，真正的朋友會留在你身邊，幫助你度過難關。
tough meat: The steak was overcooked, and the tough meat was so hard to chew that I couldn't finish it.
牛排煎得太熟了，硬的肉難咬到我吃不完。
